//: The radio road to other people. Original Prologue numbers; the ids name whitelisted things. Whoever is listening to a powered receiver when one of broadcastHours passes hears the broadcast, however long they have listened; hearing it once ends the radio's part in the story. The village is placed once per run, villageDistance hexes from home, on one of villageBiomes.
//buildSteps: 13.10.2026: the way to a working radio as ordered optional goals in the Quests panel (game RadioGoals.js): the first unfinished step is shown. A step is done while its own condition holds, once the radio exists or the broadcast was heard, or once a step named in its closedBy holds (for what practice uses up or outgrows: the scrap, the first level). A tool that is lost reopens its step. Conditions: count (id, count within reach or stored at camp), quality, skill, tool (any tool the named recipe asks for), recipe (known), parts (every component of the named recipe at hand), receiver (a radio from `receivers`), heard, all / any.

buildSteps.title: Radio 1: collect electronic scrap
buildSteps.summary: Take broken electronics apart (a television, a phone, a microwave, a wrecked robot) or search houses, shops and workshops. Keep a few pieces: practice uses them up.

buildSteps.title: Radio 2: a tool that turns screws
buildSteps.summary: Find or make anything with Screw driving 1: a screwdriver, a pocket knife with one, a multitool.

buildSteps.title: Radio 3: learn electronics, level 1
buildSteps.summary: In Crafting, open the practice recipes and run electronics salvage until the skill reaches 1. It needs the scrap and the screw tool. A book on electronics teaches the same; a good mood keeps focus up, and focus is what you learn with.

buildSteps.title: Radio 4: a soldering iron and solder
buildSteps.summary: Find a soldering iron (or a repair kit that solders) and solder wire: workshops, garages and electronics shops have them. The iron needs power: a charged battery.

buildSteps.title: Radio 5: learn electronics, level 2
buildSteps.summary: Practise electronics soldering (cable, scrap and solder), or read on. At level 2 you know how a radio is put together.

buildSteps.title: Radio 6: gather the parts and the tools
buildSteps.summary: Everything the radio is made of and everything it is built with, within reach or stored at camp. Old radios, cars and antennas give most of the parts when taken apart; flashlights, players and coffee makers hold solder and circuits.

buildSteps.title: Radio 7: build the radio
buildSteps.summary: Open Crafting and build it. Pin the recipe to see what is still missing.

buildSteps.title: Radio 8: power it and listen
buildSteps.summary: Put a charged battery in the radio and use it. The broadcast is only on the air at certain hours: try again later if you hear nothing.

village.//joy: 12.10.2026: the first ride down, once: a mood of `mood` (stored units, shown times practice.json morale.scale) that lasts `days` and fades over their second half, and the mindset track lifted by `mindset` at once.

//places: Pinned story places, one of each per run, placed like the village: 'distance' hexes from home (or from the village with around: 'village') on one of 'biomes', on ground the survivor has not seen. placeGap keeps them apart. Names are what the HUD pointer calls them.

region.//: The country around the laboratory. 'dangerFloor' rows are [within hexes, least danger]; 'enemyTables' replace the plain threat tables of wild ground there; each 'lootBonus' row is one more chance of a roll on that table when a hex of the region is first searched.

//placesVersion: placesVersion 2 (19.09.2026): the laboratory moved from 21-25 to 48-55 hexes out. A save whose laboratory was never found, revealed or seen gets the new one; any other keeps its own.
